notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l002: Six swift horses retained beside the mounted wind-camel messenger; source does not specify how the six horses travel or their recipients.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l004: бурамалуу indicates twisting/spiral formation of the brass spear; exact construction uncertain. Next row бурч literally corner/end, imer- turning/swinging, not inferred spear-throw.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l007: үзүк is the felt roof covering of a yurt, used as a simile for enormous cap. Primary1969 dictionary https://el-sozduk.kg/үзүк/.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l008: Shuutu confirmed as a named companion, not the modern operator homonym, in Manas encyclopedia https://el-sozduk.kg/kyrk-choro/.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l024: Sheath-like waist and moon-like face describe the hoped-for wife in the following row; source order retained.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l027: Азирет refers to a holy or revered person. Fearful speakers say Beijing lies beyond even such a figure’s reach; not an external claim about the city.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l031: The two көп comparisons are rhetorically repetitive; English preserves many rejoicing and many more distressed, without invented numerical proportions.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l034: ыймандыкка provisionally for service of faith in this religious elder’s arrival; precise office/ritual unspecified, not invented funeral or financial charity.
notes.manas-2010:p0979:b001:l036: Singular khan title attached to the arriving figures is syntactically compressed; no extra named khan invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l006: Literal swords of gold retained; no silent change to merely gold hilts.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l007: кылкан cereal awn/spikelet simile, for taut slender heroes; not actual human weight measurement.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l009: тулпар denotes exceptional epic racers; ала баш pied-headed retained as descriptive horse term, not assigned a new named horse.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l010: ат уйкаш is ambiguous: ат horse/name, уйкаш matching/rhyming (https://el-sozduk.kg/уй/). Neighboring horse row supports matched mounts provisionally; names Almambet and Chubak do not rhyme. No independently established idiom; exact qualification kept for specialist review.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l016: сан denotes a large host/count here; twelve retained without multiplying by an unsupported fixed number of troops.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l022: Ajybai and Bakai jointly pitch one thousand in printed wording; no silent doubling.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l026: баш-башына favors one thousand each for the forty companions; source repeated totals retained rather than normalized against earlier named individuals.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l028: жол эсеби reckoning of the journey; may include logistics, no specific route distance inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l035: арак distilled spirits taken along with other refreshment; no unsupported assumption all poured into tea.
notes.manas-2010:p0980:b001:l041: чал- ranged/scouted the meadows, subject implicit; not mowing inferred.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l001: Baabedin’s Baychoro kept as printed patronymic; do not equate automatically with religious patron Baabedin elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l005: No guests left to host, not hosts refusing food to Yrchy/Baychoro; confirmed by Bakai redistributing guests from other camps below.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l012: кызык сал- stirring a commotion in resentful threat, not harmless entertainment. No specific violence invented.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l019: салык literal levy/requisition, applied to guests; not cache sense used elsewhere.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l029: Bullet-impenetrable clothing is the epic’s claim; not independent real-world protective-equipment advice.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l033: Palm-sized/handful Muslims is affectionate diminutive, not another actual army census.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l035: Blackening burning embers retained in warning; no literal gunpowder identification inserted.
notes.manas-2010:p0981:b001:l042: кол алгын literally take a hand; provisionally acceptance/blessing from khan, not explicit instruction to receive the coats from his hand. Possible military sense receive troops remains for review; raw unchanged.
